proposal.eligible_source: Publisher-authorized finalized bars with independently verifiable first-release/version records
proposal.reference_terms_status: Public reference only. Confirm applicable version, jurisdiction, retention, and outside-organization review rights before authorizing any use.

conditions: Verify publisher terms, jurisdiction and rights before any requests or writes to external custody.
Owner approval precedes independent witnessing of the actual frozen protocol. Both precede first eligible release.
Require UTC grid and publication/version evidence. Bar close, local receipt and commit return are separate events.
Quarantine corrections and conflicts, preserve initial version and gaps, and refuse backdating or historical substitution.
Keep blind holdout bytes in a separate private custody identity without analyst read permission. Expose only commitments and counts.
Validate issuer signature, trust chain, independently retained timestamp and canonical content with real evidence before admitting any cohort.
Treat modeled fills as assumptions and keep unavailable execution evidence UNKNOWN.
The rehearsal has no collection or holdout release entry point. Real operation requires separate authorization and Audit review.
